## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek little man. Among the people of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he is commonly known as "[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde is the husband of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), residing with her in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While his wife frequently engages with community affairs and visits neighboring households like [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Thomas remains a background figure in the local area. ## Relationships

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). While he remains a quiet background presence, his wife actively engages in the community and evaluates the personal growth of local children like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Spouse of — married couple  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001)</sub>

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

[Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) is Thomas Lynde's wife. She is an observant and outspoken woman in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who keeps close tabs on the affairs of her neighbors, such as the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family, and frequently shares her strong opinions and warnings with them.

- Spouse of — husband  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)</sub>
